info.title: Family Factory private build API
info.description: Authenticated family gateway and separate private game preview. The temporary Adult development profile lives on the existing website. Paid adult calls require a valid family session AND an independent HttpOnly adult cookie AND a per-tab proof, plus an owner-issued permit and configured rollout/provider/budget gates. The family-session security alternative describes child/family mode and does not bypass runtime adult-only policy; child mode retains separately verified guardian scopes and actual provider privacy requirements. Parent privacy choices remain pending until externally verified. Neither a profile switch nor a checkbox creates consent, ZDR or a spending allowance. Browser POSTs require exact Origin, X-Factory-Request: 1 and the documented Content-Type; private responses are no-store. This schema covers build/revision/worker contracts, session status, adult activation/lock, parent unlock/privacy and read-only coach/speech readiness. Existing full conversation, binary speech and other trusted-device payload schemas remain incomplete; consult their executable handlers. Source contracts are not evidence of live deployment or paid activation.

get.summary: Read the current family session and Adult profile eligibility/activity
get.description: Family authentication is required. A family-only request reports eligibility and active:false even if the browser has an ambient adult cookie. To report adult active:true, the same request must additionally supply adultCookie AND adultProof. Invalid or expired adult proof reports active:false rather than elevating the family session. This read-only operation never unlocks a profile, renews adult access, spends money or proves provider readiness. Responses are no-store.

401.description: Missing, expired or revoked family access, or a missing/expired parent unlock where required.

403.description: Origin/CSRF mismatch, wrong family/device, invalid passphrase, or missing adult authorization for the requested operation.

503.description: Private state or the required service is unavailable. No activation or erasure success is asserted.

post.summary: Switch to the temporary Adult development profile and activate its privileged session
post.description: Requires an active trusted device in this gateway family, the existing adult/parent passphrase, a current operator-issued adult permit, and all adult rollout flags. The passphrase is checked with the shared family lockout (five failures lock for 15 minutes). The device and permit are rechecked in the admission transaction. Success immediately activates the Adult profile: it returns a per-tab proof and sets a distinct HttpOnly adult cookie; no separate AI activation endpoint or second website is required. A new unlock supersedes the prior adult grant on this device. No parent-management cookie, guardian verification, provider approval or spending allowance is granted. The grant lasts at most 60 minutes and expires with its permit; ordinary family renewal never extends it.

post.summary: End this tab Adult profile session without requiring a fresh family access token
post.description: The caller drops its in-memory proof before making this request. Revocation requires adultCookie AND adultProof matching the same live grant, device, permit and gateway family; a familySession is not required because this operation only reduces privilege. Exact Origin and X-Factory-Request: 1 remain mandatory. The empty security alternative permits idempotent inactive cleanup only: missing/invalid/expired/nonexistent adult cookies return active:false and may be cleared, but cannot revoke another grant. When an older tab proof accompanies the browser newer valid cookie, return active:false with no Set-Cookie and preserve that newer grant. Successful matching revocation clears the adult cookie and invalidates work bound to that grant. A private-store failure returns 503 with no Set-Cookie because the current cookie cannot be safely classified.

This operation does not erase device-local notebooks, game revisions, learning data, provider logs or backups, and does not revoke consent.

familySession.name: factory_session
familySession.description: Signed factory_session cookie issued by trusted family provisioning: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=None, Partitioned, Path=/v1. A device-bound session is checked against the live trusted-device record on every request. Neither a local profile name nor caller JSON establishes adult authorization. All browser POSTs additionally require the exact configured Origin, X-Factory-Request: 1 and the documented Content-Type.

workerOIDC.description: Exact repository ID, reviewed tag/SHA, workflow, environment, audience, issuer and first run attempt. Stage/run/job binding enforced.

schedulerOIDC.description: Google signed OIDC; exact scheduler account email, verified email and gateway audience.

adultCookie.name: factory_adult
adultCookie.description: Independent server-issued HttpOnly adult credential (Secure, SameSite=None, Partitioned, Path=/v1). Issued only by the passphrase-checked adult unlock on an owner-approved trusted device. The cookie alone grants no adult capability: adultProof is required in the same security requirement. The stored grant expires after at most 60 minutes, is bounded by the operator permit, and is not extended by ordinary family-session renewal.

adultProof.name: X-Factory-Adult-Session
adultProof.description: 43-character base64url proof returned by adult unlock, retained only in the active browser tab memory. It is distinct from the HttpOnly adult cookie secret. Both hashes must match the same live grant, family, trusted device and current owner permit. A local role/profile field, a cookie alone, another tab proof, or a signed family-cookie adult claim cannot replace this proof. This scheme is not OAuth and has no caller-selected scopes.

parentUnlock.name: factory_parent
parentUnlock.description: 15-minute signed parent-management cookie issued after POST /v1/devices/unlock validates the family passphrase. Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=None, Partitioned, Path=/v1/devices. Must match the familySession family and exact active trusted device. Adult AI profile access does not grant parent management, and a parent passphrase does not establish externally verified guardian consent.

clientRequestId.description: Idempotency key scoped by the authenticated family and audience; never used to select an adult profile.

url.description: Short-lived scoped preview capability on a distinct hostname. Never saved in localStorage.

AdultProfileId.description: Server-derived stable adult workspace ID for the approved trusted device. It is an audience identifier, not a credential.

enabled.description: True only when all adult development rollout flags are configured. Does not assert that any paid provider is ready.

eligible.description: The authenticated trusted device has a current owner-issued adult permit; eligibility alone never activates AI.

active.description: True only when this request supplies the matching adult cookie and per-tab proof for a live grant.

profileId.description: Eligible device workspace ID, including when eligible but not unlocked; null when ineligible.

expiresAt.description: Effective adult access deadline in Unix milliseconds, capped by both family access and adult grant expiry; null unless active.

parentPassphrase.description: The existing family parent passphrase. Never persist in browser storage or request logs.

sessionToken.description: Return as X-Factory-Adult-Session only while this tab uses the Adult profile. Keep in tab memory, never localStorage or a child profile.

expiresAt.description: Absolute adult grant deadline: at most 60 minutes from unlock and no later than the current operator permit expiry. Family renewal never extends it.

AdultLockResponse.description: The caller must discard its local proof immediately. An inactive response does not claim a different tab grant was revoked.

ParentPrivacyScopes.description: Independent requested permissions; a true choice is pending until current external guardian verification is recorded. These are not API-key/OAuth scopes or provider activation flags.

ParentPrivacyChoiceRequest.description: Exact pending-choice request. At least one scope must be true. The browser cannot supply verification timestamps, receipts, family/device IDs or a verified status.

externalVerificationRequired.description: False only for current, complete external verification evidence. Never an assertion of provider-level ZDR or paid-service readiness.

erased.description: Number of removed completed coach/audio receipt records. Aggregate accounting and audit remain; this does not delete local notebooks, games, provider logs or backups.

ownerId.description: Opaque local reference, never content or a URL. The gateway HMACs all exported references; prototype keys and :// are rejected.

AnalyticsEventsResponse.description: Durably queued observations, not proof of PostHog delivery. Disabled config accepts zero.

AllowedOrigin.name: Origin
AllowedOrigin.description: Must exactly equal the gateway configured appOrigin. No wildcard or alternate site is accepted.

OptionalAllowedOrigin.name: Origin
OptionalAllowedOrigin.description: When present, must exactly equal the gateway configured appOrigin. Cross-origin browser requests use credentialed CORS for that exact origin.

FactoryRequest.name: X-Factory-Request
FactoryRequest.description: Required explicit browser mutation/CSRF header; does not grant identity or consent.

AdultCookieIssued.description: Sets factory_adult with Path=/v1; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=None; Partitioned and Max-Age no greater than 3600 seconds (shorter when the operator permit expires sooner). Never store this credential in browser JavaScript.

AdultCookieCleared.description: When returned, clears factory_adult with the same cookie attributes and Max-Age=0. Omitted when a stale/mismatched proof accompanies a newer valid cookie; that newer grant is preserved.

ParentCookieIssued.description: Sets factory_parent with Path=/v1/devices; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=None; Partitioned; Max-Age=900.
